component.name: ZBQ
component.summary: Hi-fi player for Qobuz, local files and media servers

description.p: ZBQ plays your Qobuz subscription, your local library and your media servers (Plex, Jellyfin, Subsonic/Navidrome) through one interface. Qobuz plays through Qobuz's own web player, bit-perfect and gapless, with nothing bypassed. Animated, word-synced lyrics come from the Qobuzify lyrics server.
ZBQ is a fork of QBZ and is not affiliated with Qobuz.
